profile.summary: LCS-Training is a business that helps school districts with special education data and reporting. It offers support services, consulting, customized trainings and auditing for staff who use the Special Education Information System (SEIS) and report data to the California Longitudinal Pupil Achievement Data System (CALPADS) and the California Department of Education.
